purpose: General requirements for the doc-link plugin: goals, glossary, scope, responsibility boundaries, non-functional requirements, error handling, and the recorded decisions D-001 to D-060.
summary: Purpose and background: replacing DocAdvisor with permanent document-ID based indexing, search, reference tracking and change notification
Overall flow diagrams for setup/operation (check DLID, assign DLID, check links, build ToC, check impact) and for document search
Glossary of terms such as DLID, document ID, section ID, ToC, formal reference, content hash, and the AI roles
Scope: what is included and excluded, and the responsibility boundary between doc-link and the project management AI
Write boundary: doc-link may write only DLIDs (frontmatter doc_link_id and heading-end section IDs) into indexed documents
Non-functional requirements NFR-001 to NFR-008: rebuild consistency, determinism, idempotence, write boundary, diagnosability, resumability, scalability, generation/validation separation
Error candidates and findings that do not block ToC finalization
Decision table D-001 to D-060 covering DLID format, ToC keys, duplicate handling, reference notation, hash rules, search policy, and operation flow
Pointers to the sibling requirement documents REQ-002 to REQ-005
tasks: Understanding the overall goals and scope of doc-link
Implementing DLID assignment, ToC building, search, or reference checks
Looking up a recorded decision (D-xxx) and its rationale
Checking the allowed write range into user documents
Looking up glossary terms used in specifications
Writing or reviewing tests for doc-link behavior
title: doc-link 要件定義書 — 総論
